narrative.intro: BP Oil International has federal contract obligations totaling $379M for FY2026 to date. The vendor has won 8 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $47.4M. The FY2026 total of $379M is a partial, fiscal-year-to-date figure. The available figures are contract obligations except for award-value entries in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values. Use the year-by-year obligations to spot where buying activity concentrated by year. Treat current-year totals as incomplete because FY2026 is still in progress.
